search_google_pse: search Google Programmable Search Engine API with query, count, and optional filter list to return SearchResult objects
search_google_pse_with_pagination: search Google PSE API for 50 results using pagination to fetch pages of 10 results each
search_google_pse_with_filter: search Google PSE API and filter out results matching keywords in the filter list
search_google_pse_with_referer: search Google PSE API with a custom referer header for the HTTP request
summarize_search_google_pse: summarize the search_google_pse function that queries Google PSE and returns SearchResult objects
